entities.title: View line format
entities.summary: The text TerseView.Format writes and the view tool returns below its header: one line per kept source line or note, each starting with its source line numbers and a tab.
consumers: zazzled (macos/rust/zazzled/), which passes the view on for zazzle read of a .cs file
entities.definition: Lines joined by \n. N<TAB>text: source line N, unchanged. N~<TAB>text: source line N with a change (an access modifier dropped, var written, a local renamed). A-B<TAB>⋯ note: source lines A to B collapsed into the note. Line numbers are 1-based and those of the file; lines hidden without a note are simply absent.
guarantees: Every number is a line number of the source file, so a reader can go to that line.
entities.compatibility: No version is attached to the format; a change to it reaches zazzled once a release with a new ToolVersion.Text, taken from the tag, replaces the idle daemon through the handshake (macos/dotnet/zazzle-csharp-indexer/.dev/decisions.json, tool-version-source).
